name: Construction of Fish Markets
benefit: - For Panchayats/Municipalities with an Annual Income of up to ₹2,00,000: **100% Subsidy, Limited to ₹5,00,000.**- For Panchayats/Municipalities with an Annual Income Above ₹2,00,000: **75% Subsidy, Limited to ₹5,00,000.**
_eligibility_text: The applicant should be a local body such as a Municipality or a Village Panchayat in the State of Goa.
